text:
carlos_s: FYI getting a spike of 429s for tenant corp-x on the dedicated pool since 09:12 UTC. Customers see failures and elevated latency.

leon_infra: Can you paste a sample request + headers? Which pool and model?

carlos_s: Pool: ded-pool-us-west-2-2, model: llama-13b-8q, sample curl:
```
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" -d '{"input":"hi"}' https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
x-rw-tenant: corp-x
x-rw-rate-limit: 60
```

maria_prod: 60 looks low compared to their committed throughput. Did we apply a per-tenant override?

ops-bot: alert: tenant_rate_limit_exceeded corp-x count=412 window=60s pool=ded-pool-us-west-2-2

sre_robin: I pulled the routing config and quota table. Looks like corp-x has rate_units=60. Their contract shows 600 rps. Possible unit mismatch (per-minute vs per-second) when we ingested their CSV.

amanda_support: Customer says they started a rollout of a background job last night that increased API fanout; they only noticed after the spike.

leon_infra: Confirming: config row for corp-x -> quota_value: "3600", quota_unit: "minute". Our quota worker interprets quota_unit as "per-second" if not normalized. So 3600/60 -> 60 rps. Looks like the ingestion script forgot to normalize minute->second.

carlos_s: Oof. So we accidentally set them to 60 rps instead of 600 rps. That explains the 429s.

sre_robin: Short-term mitigation: bump the tenant limit to expected 600 rps and restart quota-svc in rolling fashion on the pool. I'll run a quick patch.

leon_infra: Command I'm going to run on control plane (dry-run first):
```
# increase corp-x quota to 600 rps
curl -X POST https://control.redwood.internal/tenants/corp-x/quota -d '{"rate":600,"unit":"second"}' -H "Authorization: Bearer ADMIN_REDACTED"
```

ops-bot: deploybot: rolling restart started for service=quota-svc pool=ded-pool-us-west-2-2 initiator=leon_infra

amanda_support: I messaged the customer that we're investigating, escalated to SRE. They asked for ETA ~10m.

leon_infra: Patch applied and quota-svc restarted on 3 nodes. Confirming metrics...

ops-bot: metric: tenant_corp-x_rate_limit 600 -> observed_ok=true

carlos_s: Seeing 200s again, 429 rate down to near zero. Customer reported degraded but improving.

billing_julie: Note: since their contract was for 600 rps, we should check if overage billing applies during the period where they were constrained. We might need to credit them for lost requests.

maria_prod: Agree — capture the window and affected token counts. Also add postmortem item: fix ingestion normalization and add a unit test.

sre_robin: Will open a P1 incident and add runbook steps: validate quota ingestion, unit normalization, config lint on apply, and a monitoring alert for sudden per-tenant 429 spikes.

leon_infra: Quick follow-up: ingestion script located at infra/tools/tenant-importer, commit 4b7f9. I'll push a PR with normalization and add an end-to-end test.

carlos_s: Thanks everyone — I'll keep the customer updated and collect logs for the postmortem. :thumbsup:
